title: Pompidou Centre
body: Centre Georges Pompidou commonly shortened to Centre Pompidou; also known as the Pompidou Centre in English) is a complex building in the Beaubourg area of the 4th arrondissement of Paris, near Les Halles, rue Montorgueil and the Marais. It was by the architectural team of Richard Rogers and Renzo Piano, along with Gianfranco Franchini.
